name: Pidilite Industries Ltd

ledger.quote: So I think that is the stuff, that may or may not substantially add to our top line and as it keeps growing. But I think that is the fuel for the future because once they become growth categories, then they start adding substantially as we go forward.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.by_when: period of 3 years from the date of going national
ledger.verdict: The three-year timeline from going national has not passed yet.

ledger.quote: So I think to answer your question, would we be deploying the expansion, if at all, in gross margin for investments? The answer is yes. We will be deploying them judiciously in A&SP, in GTM capability building.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.target: Deploy gross margin gains into A&SP and GTM
ledger.verdict: Management deployed gross margin gains into advertising and market capabilities.
ledger.evidence: A large chunk of that was advertising and sales promotion and this operating leverage flowed into the EBITDA.

ledger.quote: If the raw material prices remain benign, for the year will we definitely remain within the corridor, a little bit on the higher end of the corridor, the answer is yes.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: EBITDA margin reached 26 percent, above the 20 to 24 percent guidance.

ledger.quote: So what we are saying is that this momentum of mid-teens domestic B2B(which also has projects)we are confident that, that momentum will continue.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Domestic B2B volume growth reached 7.3 percent.
ledger.evidence: B2B underlying volume growth for the quarter was 7.3 percent

ledger.quote: Rather than saying when will it be substantial, I will say that in the immediate or medium-term defined as let's say, 6 months or 12 months, some of these initiatives which we are showing now are not going to be material to the size of Pidilite.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: The 6 to 12 month period has not fully elapsed for newer initiatives.

ledger.quote: We've demonstrated that we've delivered double-digit underlying volume growth for some quarters, and we are confident that we can do it in the future. You're absolutely right.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Standalone underlying volume growth reached 11.3 percent.

ledger.quote: If you look at our 9 months consolidated growth, that is around 10%. So therefore, you are seeing a fillip in the growth.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Nine months consolidated revenue growth reached around 10 percent.
ledger.evidence: Dec 2025 revenue YoY 10.1 percent, Sep 2025 YoY 9.9 percent

ledger.quote: I think would be our endeavor, but will it flow through as a formulate number quarter-on-quarter, year-over-year, perhaps no.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Price increases were taken across categories to offset input costs.
ledger.evidence: As we had mentioned in the full year earnings call, we had taken price increases and which were taken across all categories

ledger.quote: So I think, therefore, to answer your question, no, if I could say so. This is a buoyancy. And as we were seeing earlier, see, the thing is that we have seen this buoyancy and therefore, what has happened is that our growth categories have delivered very well on growth.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: And our focus, Abneesh, as I'm telling again and again, Sandeep and I have been absolutely reiterating is to drive underlying volume growth to drive demand and to stay steadfast on growth.
ledger.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats
ledger.verdict: Standalone underlying volume growth reached 11.3 percent.
ledger.evidence: Standalone revenues grew by 22.2 percent with an underlying volume growth of 11.3 percent.

ledger.quote: So our capex in the year also was higher than what we had spent in the previous year. With this, I open the floor for Q&A.
ledger.speaker: Sandeep Batra
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

open.quote: As a matter of fact, our endeavor will be to slowly but surely inch it up a little bit.
open.speaker: Sudhanshu Vats

read: Management consistently delivers volume growth targets and deploys margins into advertising. Operating margins exceed the stated 20 to 24 percent corridor.
